hook: The 1926 Army-Navy YMCA between Mission and Howard, now the Harbor Court Hotel at 165 and the Embarcadero YMCA at 169.

assessment.note: These are the 2024 roll's figures, the last on which the parcel was assessed as one property. The 2025 roll assesses the two condominium lots separately and records no year built, stories or building area for either.

historical_record.description: The Embarcadero YMCA was completed here in 1926 between Mission and Howard, with a gymnasium and rooms for rent upstairs; named as potentially eligible for landmark designation.
The building held the Harbor Court Hotel at 165 Steuart Street and the Embarcadero YMCA at 169.

A condominium map was recorded over the parcel, dividing it into two lots — 161–165 Steuart Street and 169 Steuart Street — on one mapped parcel. The city drew the split onto its basemap on 28 May 2026 and retired the parcel the building had stood on since 1998.
